command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
F2_SHA=eaf59d7ae95eea178a0a26bc2b87927e7429a099
F2_REPO=https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein-2.0.git
CLAIM=research/local_voice/claims/2026-09-02_trigger7_gpt56sol_completion_depth_g2.json
CLAIM_BLOB=de2ace48e0e7e1d563cbd19551b765ddf2fddabf
TOOL=research/local_voice/tools/t4_voice_virtual_sink_cancel_readback.py
TOOL_BLOB=a18ce3f930d7de918572b4807e21532f805c64a7
SEMANTIC_KEY=0d83f7d13c1d8f91686cf94070f73d901a49018b40a9c058d1949af094655bff
WORK=/tmp/t4-g2-pipewire-monitor-repaired-a2
rm -rf "$WORK"; mkdir -p "$WORK/runtime" "$WORK/home"
chmod 700 "$WORK/runtime"
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ]; then
  apt-get update -qq
  DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq git python3 dbus pipewire pipewire-pulse pipewire-bin pulseaudio-utils >/dev/null
fi
for c in git python3 dbus-run-session pipewire pipewire-pulse pactl pacat parec; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null || { echo "MISSING_COMMAND:$c" >&2; exit 31; }; done
git clone -q --filter=blob:none --no-checkout "$F2_REPO" "$WORK/f2"
git -C "$WORK/f2" checkout -q --detach "$F2_SHA"
test "$(git -C "$WORK/f2" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$F2_SHA"
test "$(git -C "$WORK/f2" rev-parse HEAD:$CLAIM)" = "$CLAIM_BLOB"
test "$(git -C "$WORK/f2" rev-parse HEAD:$TOOL)" = "$TOOL_BLOB"
cat > "$WORK/run.sh" <<'SH'
set -Eeuo pipefail
export HOME=__HOME__
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=__RUNTIME__
export PIPEWIRE_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"
export PULSE_RUNTIME_PATH="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pulse"
mkdir -p "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" "$HOME"
chmod 700 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"
PW_LOG=__WORK__/pipewire.log
PP_LOG=__WORK__/pipewire-pulse.log
pipewire >"$PW_LOG" 2>&1 & PW_PID=$!
cleanup(){ set +e; [ -n "${PP_PID:-}" ] && kill "$PP_PID" 2>/dev/null; kill "$PW_PID" 2>/dev/null; wait "${PP_PID:-0}" 2>/dev/null; wait "$PW_PID" 2>/dev/null; }
trap cleanup EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 100); do [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pipewire-0" ] && break; sleep 0.05; done
[ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pipewire-0" ] || { echo PIPEWIRE_SOCKET_NOT_READY >&2; exit 32; }
pipewire-pulse >"$PP_LOG" 2>&1 & PP_PID=$!
for i in $(seq 1 100); do [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pulse/native" ] && break; sleep 0.05; done
[ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pulse/native" ] || { echo PIPEWIRE_PULSE_SOCKET_NOT_READY >&2; exit 33; }
export PULSE_SERVER=unix:$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pulse/native
for i in $(seq 1 100); do pactl info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 0.05; done
INFO=$(pactl info)
echo "$INFO" | grep -q 'PipeWire' || { echo "PACTL_SERVER_NOT_PIPEWIRE" >&2; echo "$INFO" >&2; exit 34; }
echo T4_G2_A2_BINDING_BEGIN
printf 'F2_SHA=%s\nCLAIM_BLOB=%s\nTOOL_BLOB=%s\nSEMANTIC_KEY=%s\n' '__F2_SHA__' '__CLAIM_BLOB__' '__TOOL_BLOB__' '__SEMANTIC_KEY__'
pipewire --version | head -n 2
pipewire-pulse --version | head -n 2
echo "$INFO" | sed -n '1,14p'
echo T4_G2_A2_BINDING_END
set +e
python3 __F2_DIR__/research/local_voice/tools/t4_voice_virtual_sink_cancel_readback.py --backend pulse-null --out __WORK__/g2-result.json
RC=$?
set -e
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
p=pathlib.Path('__WORK__/g2-result.json')
if not p.exists():
    print('G2_RESULT_MISSING', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(35)
r=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert r.get('semantic_key') == '__SEMANTIC_KEY__', r.get('semantic_key')
assert r.get('research_id') == 'T7-20260902-PIPEWIRE-MONITOR-CANCEL-G2', r.get('research_id')
assert r.get('execution_scope') == 'VPS_PIPEWIRE_MONITOR_CANDIDATE', r.get('execution_scope')
print('T4_G2_A2_RESULT_BEGIN')
print(json.dumps(r, sort_keys=True, indent=2))
print('T4_G2_A2_RESULT_END')
if r.get('pass'):
    assert r['old_sentinel_queued_before_cancel'] is True
    assert r['generation_advanced_before_sink_cancel'] is True
    assert r['late_old_generation_accepted'] is False
    assert r['old_sentinel_samples'] > 0
    assert r['old_sentinel_samples'] < r['expected_old_sentinel_samples_without_cancel']
    assert r['residual_old_samples_after_cancel_bound_model'] <= r['max_residual_old_samples']
    assert r['new_sentinel_samples'] > 0
    assert r['evidence']['pipewire_monitor_promotion_candidate'] == 1
    assert r['evidence']['target_runtime_credit_from_probe_alone'] == 0
    for k in ('producer_generation_cancel','true_streaming_partial_asr','physical_speaker','physical_microphone','human_heard_output','acoustic_playback_readback','whole_voice_e2e','gwt_jspace','effect','unifieddb_write','training','whole_product'):
        assert r['evidence'][k] == 0, (k,r['evidence'][k])
PY
echo T4_G2_A2_DRIVER_RC=$RC
exit "$RC"
SH
sed -i \
  -e "s|__HOME__|$WORK/home|g" \
  -e "s|__RUNTIME__|$WORK/runtime|g" \
  -e "s|__WORK__|$WORK|g" \
  -e "s|__F2_DIR__|$WORK/f2|g" \
  -e "s|__F2_SHA__|$F2_SHA|g" \
  -e "s|__CLAIM_BLOB__|$CLAIM_BLOB|g" \
  -e "s|__TOOL_BLOB__|$TOOL_BLOB|g" \
  -e "s|__SEMANTIC_KEY__|$SEMANTIC_KEY|g" \
  "$WORK/run.sh"
export WORK F2_SHA
dbus-run-session -- bash "$WORK/run.sh"
